t: What Industrial Quality Control Database Is All About
title: What Industrial Quality Control Database Is All About
description: Industrial quality control inspects by plan: incoming (verify suppliers), in-process (SPC at the machine), final (audit before ship). Control limits (±3σ) differ from spec limits; AQL sampling (MIL-STD-105) balances inspection cost. The quality manual (ISO 9001) runs it as a system. Corrective action (8D) fixes causes, not just defects. This database is the complete quality control record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
